d:
Raja Saheb is a rich man, strict father to sons Virendra and Mahendra. One day, Mahendra has a big fight with his father and dies of shock afterwards. Virendra leaves home and falls in bad company. Later, Virendra falls in love with a poor girl , eventually deciding to marry her. At home, a lonely Raja Saheb falls ill. When Virendra tells his father about his love, his father reveals his own past: He was in love with a poor girl, who died leaving her daughter behind, who dances on the roads to earn a living. Virendra decides to bring his sister home.
Movie:- Bhai Bahen (1969)
